answer: Sybil resistance comes from pricing time, not keys. Before an attestation carries weight, its identity must forge a bond that unlocks only after N closed epochs, so a fresh key scores zero until then. A farm therefore pays rent and latency on every clone while it waits, and weighted-random seat draws mean a quill of clone keys cannot crowd the grading panel the way first-come seating would. Slashed bonds burn as shale, destroying attacker capital instead of recycling it. Cost per fake vote is rent times N epochs against a patient defender.
